propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; always() predicates on full-route jobs remain true when run is canceled, causing stale matrix/reusable jobs to continue until natural completion instead of being promptly canceled

Replacing always() with !cancelled() status checks in the seven full-route job predicates makes superseded runs promptly cancel their stale jobs while preserving the docs-only fallback contract and classifier-failure full-route eligibility

Live organic same-change replacement pairs (PS3→PS4→PS5) demonstrated successor job admission within 78–110 seconds of stale run creation, with predecessor matrix/mutation jobs stopping 17–96 seconds after replacement, confirming prompt cancellation behavior

The vote/finalization job cancellation-aware behavior, matrix cell commands, and coverage assertions remain unchanged; only the cancellation status portion of the seven full-route predicates is modified
